name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No tropical cyclones active in the Atlantic on 11 Nov; GDACS lists only two weakening Pacific systems
state: GDACS listed no Atlantic tropical cyclone on 11 Nov; its only current entries, Pena and Cempaka, are in the western Pacific and rated green (GDACS). The National Hurricane Center's Atlantic discussion of 9 Nov reported no tropical cyclones. With no storm threatening land, the signal stays Normal; the season formally ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No action needed. In the Atlantic hurricane region, follow the National Hurricane Center and local emergency agencies.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land within 5 days

sources.title: NOAA NHC — Tropical Weather Discussion, Atlantic

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).
